source.publisher: National Statistics Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan
source.title: Wholesale trade volume (by month)
source.standardized_units: million UZS; 1 billion UZS = 1000 million UZS
source.interpretation: Year-to-date turnover/service volume; within-year differences, January reset. These are aggregates, not borrower cash flow or expense records.
source.methodology_policy: Use published contiguous observations; retain negative revisions and exclude affected forecasting windows.

source.publisher: National statistics committee  of the Republic of Uzbekistan
source.title: Volume of market services rendered (monthly, by districts and cities)
source.standardized_units: million UZS; 1 billion UZS = 1000 million UZS
source.interpretation: Year-to-date turnover/service volume; within-year differences, January reset. These are aggregates, not borrower cash flow or expense records.
source.provider_note: Starting from September 2024, the data have been compiled including the results of statistical surveys conducted to estimate the informal and hidden economy by regions; The data are preliminary and may be revised in subsequent publications.
source.methodology_policy: Service series exclude pre-September-2024 observations and the September transition increment; October differences use two totals under the new survey definition.
